title: 2027 Graduate Scheme - Commercial Real Estate - Dublin
description: **Commercial Real Estate Graduate** Closing Date - 16th October 2026 Start Date - September 2027 *€33,000* *+ benefits* In joining CBRE’s Next Generation Cohort, you will be shaping the future of Real Estate. You will have excellent training and mentoring from industry experts and specialists, who will share invaluable knowledge and experience with you. You will be a part of a wider cohort of like-minded young professionals who you will develop with in your career. We give you the opportunity to work on world class projects, with an unmatched portfolio of clients, so that you gain the knowledge, skills and ability to become the future leaders and our Next Generation of CBRE. **About the Opportunity** Our Commercial Graduate Programme is 3 years long and offers the breadth of experience needed to work at the heart of the real estate industry. Throughout your time on the programme, you can expect to work across a minimum of three departments. These may include: Agency, Asset Management, Capital Markets and Valuation. This structured programme is centred on the completion of the Assessment of Professional Competence (APC) through the Society of Chartered Surveyors Ireland (SCSI). Non-cognate pathway: Students will still complete their APC within the 3-year timeframe, but in addition will complete a part-time SCSI-accredited Masters over 2 years, fully funded by CBRE. **What You’ll Do** * Attending client meetings and presenting your findings, gaining valuable experience in client interaction and communication. * Participating in regular training sessions and workshops to enhance your professional skills and knowledge in commercial real estate. * Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver comprehensive real estate solutions to clients. * Utilising industry-specific software and real estate analytics tools to perform tasks efficiently, including calculating rental, rating and valuation figures. * Conducting market research to identify trends and opportunities in the commercial real estate sector. * Inspecting and measuring properties and undertaking viewings. * Drafting schedules and reports and preparing sales particulars. * Meeting deadlines set by colleagues, clients and peers. * Being office-based on each working day, to maximise learning and collaboration within your team. * Working additional hours from time to time as required by the role. **What You’ll Need** * A forward-thinking and enthusiastic individual with a passion for real estate & the built environment * Self-motivated with good written and verbal communication skills * Strong work ethic and proactive with a positive attitude * Attention to detail, accuracy and good time management * Permission to work in the Ireland by the start of employment. * Cognate students will need an SCSI-accredited degree or equivalent (achieved or on track for a 2:2 minimum) * OR, non-cognate students from any degree discipline are welcome to apply (achieved or on track for a 2:2 minimum) * Good MS Office skills including Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint\* *\* Not an essential requirement for the role, but desired* **The Application process** * Online job-focused testing * Phone screening * Assessment Centre (held in October) * Interview **Benefits** * Dedicated learning and development team * 20 days holiday + 2 faith days * Yearly salary reviews and discretionary bonus * Plus many more… **Why CBRE** When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants. **Applicant AI Use Disclosure** We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

title: 2027 Ireland Electrical Engineering Placement Opportunity
description: To apply for this opportunity simply upload a CV. This is a placement opportunity that will typically start in around March and last for 6-12 months, however, we are flexible and will discuss your preferred dates during the selection process. **To avoid missing out on your preferred role, we recommend applying** **as early as possible, as positions will close once filled.** **Application process** * Upload CV and cover letter, detailing motivations and suitability for the opportunity. * Online strengths-based assessment This opportunity uses a single-stage strengths-based interview as part of the selection process. Start your career with a global, employee-owned consultancy where your work can make a real difference. At Mott MacDonald, you'll work alongside experts, contribute to meaningful projects, and have the support, learning opportunities, and experience needed to grow your career from day one. **Job Description** This placement opportunity will sit in our Transmission and Distribution (T&D) team who play a crucial role in transforming and modernising electricity networks to support the global energy transition. During your placement, you could contribute to projects involving substations, overhead lines, underground cables, grid connections and the integration of renewable energy. Supported by experienced engineers, you may assist with technical studies, design development, data analysis, calculations and the preparation of reports and drawings, while gaining an understanding of safety, sustainability, quality and client requirements across the project lifecycle. **What You’ll Experience** * Collaboration & Community: Work alongside diverse teams who are passionate, supportive, and driven by shared purpose. * Real-World Impact: Contribute to meaningful projects that make a difference - for our business, our communities, and the world. * Learning & Growth: Gain hands-on experience, develop your technical and professional skills, and learn how multidisciplinary teams take projects from early feasibility and design through to delivery. You’ll receive guidance and feedback from experienced colleagues as you discover what drives you. * Belonging & Inclusion: Be part of a culture where everyone is respected, heard, and empowered to thrive. **Candidate Specification** At Mott MacDonald, we’re looking for curious, motivated graduates who want to make a real difference. Join our purpose-driven teams where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work enhances the world we live in. To be eligible for this opportunity, you will have less than 12 months’ relevant experience **(excluding placements** ) and be studying towards an Electrical Engineering degree In your application, you should aim to demonstrate your genuine interest in both the opportunity and in joining Mott MacDonald. You can do this by highlighting any relevant experience or interests - such as modules you've studied, previous work experience, or any research you've undertaken about our company, values, and projects. We personally review every completed application form we receive as this part of our selection process is entirely human led. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story. We are looking for graduates with the following strengths: * Proactively takes initiative to complete tasks efficiently and independently. * Communicates effectively and clearly with clients and colleagues. * Delivers high quality written work with strong attention to detail and clarity. * Demonstrates a structured and analytical approach to problem solving. **AI Usage** At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application. **Accessibility** We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at **reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com** and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help. **About Your Development** A graduate position should be more than just a job. We know this and so do you. That’s why with our graduate roles we aim to give you the experience and technical knowledge you need to progress your career. From the moment you join us, you’ll receive the training you need. You will be assigned a mentor, who will guide you to meet the objectives of your professional training needs. You will join our three-year early careers soft skills development programme – Accelerating your Future, which is designed to give you the skills and tools necessary for a long-lasting successful career here at Mott MacDonald. **Our social side** Being part of Mott MacDonald means more than just work; there’s a huge range of fun and exciting things that you can get involved in. From the moment you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your social and professional network, whether it’s meeting other graduates or joining forces with other members of staff from around the company at our annual sports day. Each of our offices have a sports and social committee which will give you the chance to be part of a variety of sports, social and charity events. We’re committed to promoting a strong culture of social responsibility and encourage our staff to play active roles in the local community. It's worth noting that sports and social committees tend to vary from office to office, so as well as getting involved in what’s already on offer, don’t be afraid to suggest new events or initiatives that you think could be a great addition. It doesn’t stop there. From your first day, you’ll have access to Perks at Work, giving you discounts on cinema tickets, travel, utilities and much more, helping you make the most of our employee benefits. **Agile working** At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well-being, flexibility, and trust. **Equality, diversity, and inclusion** We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where **everyone** feels they can contribute. **We offer some fantastic benefits including:** * Biannual salary reviews: We believe hard work should be recognised and rewarded. To support your development and progression, you'll be eligible for salary reviews twice a year during your first three years with us, subject to successfully completing your probation period. * Flexible working * Pension matched up to 7% of base salary * Competitive annual leave * An annual professional institution subscription * Life insurance * Income continuance * Enhanced Paternity leave * Annual company performance bonus scheme – Subject to company performance * Cycle to work scheme * Travel TaxSaver tickets * Commitment to Continuing Professional Development – we are accredited by Engineers Ireland * A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self-development options. **Networks, communities, and social outcomes** * Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities. * Make a difference within our communities through our social outcomes. Location(s): Dublin, IE Contract Type: Contract Work Pattern: Full Time Market: Energy Discipline: Electrical Job Ref: 17563 Recruiter Contact: earlycareers.recruitment@mottmac.com

title: 2027 Software Dev Engineer Intern
description: **Description** Do you want to solve business challenges through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on cutting-edge, scalable services technology in a team environment? Do you like working on industry-defining projects that move the needle? At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The intense focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Our interns write real software and collaborate with a selected group of experienced software development engineers who help interns on projects that matter to our customers. We want to you to feel welcomed, included and valued right from the start. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth. How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow. **We Have Two Different Internship Durations Available** * 3 months internship * 6 months internship Please ensure to indicate your availability during the application process. Key job responsibilities * Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring to market innovative products and services. * Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry. * Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed. * Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use. * Work in an agile environment to deliver high quality software. A day in the life As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor. You will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead mission critical projects early in your career. Your design, code, and raw smarts will contribute to solving some of the most complex technical challenges in the areas of distributed systems, data mining, automation, optimisation, scalability, and security – just to name a few. In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting. Many of our technologies overlap, and you would be hard pressed to find a team that is not using Amazon Web Services (AWS), touching the catalogue, or iterating services to better personalise for customers. We make the impossible, possible. **Basic Qualifications** * Are enrolled in a Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields at time of application * Knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++, Python, Java or Perl * Knowledge of computer science fundamentals such as object-oriented design, operating systems, algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience from a technical internship * Experience with distributed, multi-tiered systems, algorithms, and relational databases * Experience in optimization mathematics such as linear programming and nonlinear optimization * Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences * Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. **Company** - Amazon Development Centre Ireland Limited - D94 Job ID: A10418355

title: 3D Fit Trainee
description: **Company Description** Because you can see how we can be better. Innovate, your way. Quality at Primark What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way. **What You’ll Ge****t**: People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Let’s talk lifestyle: * 27 days of leave, pension. * Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria. **Job Description** **What You’ll Do as a** **3D Fit Trainee** We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities: * Support the maintenance and governance of the Global Block Library and related digital tools, ensuring fit blocks, grading standards, and seasonal information are accurate, up to date, and accessible to internal stakeholders and suppliers. * Assist with the rollout and application of Fit Expression, Length Guides, fit standards, and grading rules to help deliver a consistent customer fit experience across Womenswear, Menswear, and Childrenswear. * Develop technical knowledge of apparel grading, sizing, and fit principles, supporting accurate product fit, size progression, and adherence to best-practice standards. * Collaborate with Buying, Design, QA teams, and the global supply base to support the adoption of digital fitting technologies and emerging product development processes. * Support fit-focused projects through the maintenance of technical documentation, digital assets, training materials, and guidance resources, helping to build capability across stakeholders and suppliers. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by analysing fit-related feedback, supporting KPI reporting, and leveraging digital tools to improve efficiency, consistency, and product development outcomes. **Qualifications** **What You’ll Bring** Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular: * Relevant qualification in Pattern Cutting, Garment Technology, Fashion Design, or a related discipline, with 1–2 years' experience or a graduate background in apparel product development. * Strong interest in garment fit, sizing, product development, and pattern technology, with a desire to build technical expertise across apparel categories. * Understanding of, or willingness to learn, digital product development tools such as CLO 3D, Browzwear, or similar 3D design platforms. * Basic knowledge of garment construction, manufacturing processes, and apparel grading principles, with an eagerness to develop expertise in fit and size progression. * Awareness of fabric properties and performance characteristics, with an understanding of their impact on garment fit, construction, quality, and overall product performance. **Additional Information** Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours. ***About Primark*** At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 500 stores in 20 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together. If you need any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request, during your recruitment journey, such as extended time or breaks between online assessments, a sign language interpreter, mobility access, or assistive technology please contact your talent acquisition specialist. All offers of employment are subject to background checks, including right to work, reference education and for some roles criminal, and financial checks. If you have any concerns, please reach out to our talent acquisition team to discuss. **#LI-Hybrid**

title: Accommodation Assistant

title: Account Development Representative, Italian Speaking

Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world! title: Accountant
description: Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com. **What You’ll Be Part Of** Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder. **What You’ll Be Responsible For** As an Accountant, you will take end to end ownership of assigned accounting areas across operating costs, cash transactions, payroll and employee related costs, share based compensation, fixed assets and intangible assets, including internally developed intangible assets. You will own the accounting, close and controls for your areas, while developing a strong understanding of the underlying data and processes and using AI and automation to improve quality, efficiency and scalability. **What You’ll Work On** * Own key month end and quarter end accounting activities across operating costs, payroll and employee related costs, share based compensation, fixed and intangible assets and leases, including journal entries, reconciliations, accruals, capitalisation and other period end adjustments. * Work with cash transactions and large accounting datasets, using analytical and AI enabled tools to identify exceptions, investigate unusual items and ensure transactions are complete, accurately classified and appropriately reflected in the financial statements. * Analyse balance sheet and P&L movements, get to the root cause of unexpected results and provide clear, evidence based commentary on key drivers. * Develop a strong understanding of the business activity, data and systems behind your accounting areas. Approach unfamiliar or non routine transactions with curiosity, research the accounting and form a point of view under relevant U.S. GAAP, escalating complex matters where appropriate. * Prepare supporting schedules, financial reporting and assigned SEC disclosures, and perform relevant ICFR and SOX controls with high quality documentation and testing readiness. * Take ownership of problems and drive them through to resolution, working across Finance and the wider business to improve upstream data, processes and controls rather than simply addressing issues at month end. * Support audit, tax and compliance requirements, proactively resolving issues and maintaining high quality supporting documentation. * Use AI and automation as part of how you work: experiment with new tools, challenge manual processes and identify, design and implement solutions that improve the speed, quality and scalability of accounting, while maintaining appropriate human judgement, governance and controls. **What You’ll Bring To Circle** We are looking for someone who combines strong accounting fundamentals with curiosity, judgement, ownership and a bias for action. description: **Job Title:** Campus and Theatre Porter **Post Status:** Permanent **Department** Portering **Location:** St. Joseph Hospital, Raheny Dublin / Beaumont Hospital **Reports to:** Head of Portering **Salary:** Appointment will be made onthe Theatre Porter Scal (€36,651 - €45,939) at a point in line with Government pay policy. The post-holder will work closely with nursing, medical, clinical and support services to facilitate the safe movement and care of patients, equipment, medical gases, clinical samples, blood products, furniture, supplies and other hospital items. The post-holder will undertake additional specialist responsibilities including stock ordering and control, management and decontamination of specialist clinical equipment, Support and assistance to nursing staff with patient care and repositioning. **Responsibilities** **General Portering and Patient Transport** * Safely transport patients to and from wards, departments, diagnostic areas and theatres for tests, procedures and transfers of care. * Assess the most appropriate method of patient transport in conjunction with the patient and clinical staff, including walking escort, wheelchair, trolley or bed. * Use appropriate manual-handling techniques, hoists and other aids to ensure the safety of patients and staff. * Confirm patient identity and destination to ensure the right patient reaches the right place at the right time. * Communicate clearly and compassionately with patients and relatives regarding the purpose and route of transport. * Raise concerns with appropriate clinical staff if a patient appears unsuitable or unfit for transfer. * Maintain patient dignity, privacy and confidentiality at all times, including when moving and handling deceased patients. * Transport beds, bed tables, linen, waste, soiled linen, medical devices, equipment, patient charts, documents and other items as requested. * Transport clinical samples in accordance with relevant procedures and infection-control requirements. * Collect and deliver blood products without delay and in accordance with Blood Bank guidelines and required timeframes. * Transport, replace and regularly check medical gases in accordance with hospital policies and procedures. * Respond promptly and calmly to emergency calls and alerts. * Undertake general portering duties throughout the Campus and participate in relevant overtime arrangements where required. * Rotate into Theatre Department at St Joseph’s Hospital (full training will be provided) **Stock Ordering and Control** * Order departmental supplies as required, excluding drugs. * Ensure supplies are ordered appropriately, are not over-ordered and are rotated. * Ensure adequate stock is available in advance of weekends, planned leave and other periods of increased demand. * Put away deliveries and dispose of excess packaging in accordance with waste-management procedures. * Order urgent or ad-hoc supplies and special stock when required. * Liaise with relevant companies and suppliers regarding specific orders when required. * Use designated hospital systems to place and manage stock orders. * Liaise closely with nursing and clinical staff regarding stock requirements. * Liaise with Dietetics and Physiotherapy regarding their stock requirements within the unit. * Maintain store rooms and utility rooms in a clean, orderly and safe condition. * Provide advice and guidance regarding specific products and ordering requirements for specialist equipment where trained and appropriate. **Infection Prevention, Health and Safety** * Comply with all hospital infection-prevention and control policies and procedures. * Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) as required. * Follow safe procedures when handling contaminated equipment, clinical waste, soiled linen, bodily fluids and potentially infectious materials. * Apply appropriate manual-handling techniques at all times. * Assess loads before lifting or moving and use trolleys, hoists and other equipment where required. * Report hazards, incidents, equipment defects and safety concerns through the appropriate hospital procedures. * Complete required documentation and incident reports. * Maintain a safe, clean and orderly working environment. **Training and Development** * Undertake all mandatory and additional training provided by St. Joseph’s Hospital. * Maintain mandatory training requirements and keep relevant training records up to date. * Complete training in manual handling, infection prevention and control, PPE, DECT systems and basic life support where required. * Undertake training relevant to specialist equipment and duties. * Provide on-the-job training, instruction, advice and guidance to new or temporary Portering staff where required and where appropriately trained. * Participate in the introduction and testing of new equipment and procedures as required. **Professional Standards** * Treat patients, relatives, visitors and colleagues with dignity, respect and compassion. * Maintain confidentiality in accordance with hospital requirements. * Work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. * Demonstrate reliability, flexibility and willingness to support colleagues and other departments. * Work within the limits of training, competence and hospital policy. * Escalate concerns regarding patient safety, equipment, stock, infection control or service delivery to the appropriate person. * Maintain a professional standard of conduct at all times. **Flexibility and Service Requirements** The Porter may be required to work across different departments and areas of St. Joseph’s Hospital & RCNU according to service requirements. title: Graduate Structural Engineer
description: **Overview** **Graduate Structural Engineer** John Sisk & Son are looking for proactive, talented Structural Engineering G raduates across the **Ireland** , including all regions to join our 202 7 Early Careers Graduate Programme. **The role** Our structured 27-month graduate programme is designed to give you hands-on experience across a wide range of construction projects, helping you build the career you want. If you’ve recently graduated or are about to graduate, with a degree in Structural Engineering , and you're ready to take charge of your future with a leading building contractor, we could be the perfect fit. This is your opportunity to make an impact and grow with us. **Who We Are** Established in 1859, Sisk is proud to be in its fifth generation of family ownership. Our founding values of care, excellence, and integrity continue to shape everything we do. With a clear vision of Building Excellence, we consistently deliver high-quality projects that exceed client expectations. Our people are the driving force behind our success, and we’re now looking for the next generation of graduates to help us carry that legacy forward. **A journey to your future** Our Graduate Programme is a carefully designed 27-month rotational journey that offers up to three business rotations across the UK, Ireland, and Europe, giving you broad exposure and the opportunity to shape your career path, fusing technical excellence, commercial acumen, and leadership capabilities. From day one, you'll follow a detailed development plan aligned to a clear timeline, ensuring you gain the experience and competencies required to pursue professional chartership. We’re committed to helping you build a strong technical foundation and excel in your chosen area of specialism. The programme blends structured learning, hands-on project work, and expert mentoring to deliver both depth and breadth of knowledge. With robust progress tracking, regular feedback, and a dedicated support network, you’ll be empowered to grow with confidence and make a meaningful impact. **What We are looking For** * A collaborative team player with fresh ideas, ready to challenge yourself, and us, every step of the way. With a passion for the built environment and a drive to make a difference, you’ll bring curiosity, resilience, and a commitment to technical excellence. * Recently graduated or be on track to graduate with a Structural Engineering degree, ready to join Sisk’s Early Careers Graduate Programme in September 202 7 . Over 27 months, you’ll complete up to three rotations across the business gaining exposure to live projects, commercial operations, and technical delivery. * Geographic mobility is essential - you’ll be expected to work across the UK, Ireland, and mainland Europe, including at least one rotation outside of your home jurisdiction . The selection process has been designed to ensure that we, as a company, select the right individuals that will thrive with us, but also that you, as a candidate, select the right company to build and shape your career with. In return, you will receive a competitive salary, a focused and structured start to your career and its progression in the construction industry, with excellent support and guidance every step of the way. If your application is successful, you will be required to participate in an online psychometric assessment. The programme will commence in September 2027.

title: Graduate Traffic Engineer - Dublin (2027 start)
description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** **About the Role** AECOM is looking for talented and motivated graduates to join our Traffic Engineering teams across the UK and Ireland (UK&I). As one of the largest dedicated Traffic Engineering teams in the UK&I, we work on a diverse range of projects focused on creating safer, more efficient and sustainable transport networks for communities. Our work covers the development and appraisal of practical solutions for pedestrians, cyclists and vehicles, including road and street design, traffic signals, cycle facilities, traffic management and traffic modelling. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers and other technical professionals in multidisciplinary teams to develop innovative, cost-effective solutions for our clients. Projects range from concept and preliminary design through to modelling, detailed design and implementation, giving you the opportunity to gain experience across the full project lifecycle. The role is fast-paced and collaborative, requiring creativity, technical capability, strong communication and a willingness to learn. **What You’ll Do** As a Graduate Traffic Engineer, you’ll be supported by experienced engineers who will provide guidance and mentoring as you develop your technical knowledge and professional skills. You’ll work on live projects and receive structured training to help you build a strong foundation in traffic engineering and design. Your initial responsibilities will typically include supporting the development of designs and technical solutions through different project stages, attending site visits, meetings and workshops, and working collaboratively with clients and other design professionals. You’ll receive training in relevant engineering, design and traffic modelling software, which may include AutoCAD, Civil 3D, LinSig, TRANSYT and VISSIM, depending on project requirements. You’ll also develop your understanding of digital engineering and BIM processes. As your experience and confidence grow, you’ll take on increasing responsibility for project tasks and technical deliverables, with opportunities to contribute to projects from inception through to completion. You may gain experience across a variety of projects, including: * Road and street design * Junction and intersection design * Cycle lane and active travel design * Bus priority and Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) schemes * Streetscape and urban improvement projects * Traffic management planning and design * Traffic signal design * Traffic signage and road markings * Traffic modelling and microsimulation * Traffic impact assessments and transport assessments * Network analysis and optimisation * Feasibility studies and scheme development * Road safety assessments and audits Our Traffic Engineering graduates also have opportunities to work alongside our Highways teams on major highways projects. Working collaboratively across Traffic Engineering and Highway disciplines provides exposure to a broad range of projects and helps you develop a well-rounded understanding of transportation and infrastructure design. **Qualifications** * BEng in Civil Engineering, General Engineering or Geography, with a 2:1 (or equivalent) or above. * MEng in Civil Engineering or General Engineering, with a 2:1 (or equivalent) or above, would be advantageous. * MA/MSc in Geography, Transport Planning or a related discipline would be advantageous. * A relevant Master’s degree in Mathematics or another quantitative discipline would also be considered. * Genuine interest in traffic engineering, transport and the development of safe, efficient and sustainable transport networks. * Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret and evaluate technical information. * Basic proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel. * Good technical and report-writing skills. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with colleagues, clients and other stakeholders. * Ability to structure and prioritise work effectively while contributing to the wider team. * Ability to work collaboratively and independently, demonstrating initiative, focus and a willingness to learn. * Enthusiastic, technically minded and motivated, with ambition and drive. * Commitment to continuous learning and professional development. **Additional Information** * Applicants are encouraged to apply as early as possible since CVs will be reviewed, and candidates selected for an advanced offer start. * Please include a covering letter with your application and provide all predicted and/or obtained academic grades. * You must have permanent right to work in the UK as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM. **Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity** You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed. You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients. AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too. Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours. We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. **ReqID:** REF59630H **Business Line:** Transportation **Business Group:** DCS **Strategic Business Unit:** Europe & India **Career Area:** Engineering **Work Location Model:** Hybrid

attention to detail * Strong analytical thinking & methodical approach. * Strong trouble shooting and issue resolution skills. * Excellent, verbal and written communication. * Ability to work independently, under pressure and to tight deadlines. * Proficient in Word, Excel and PowerPoint **Benefits:** * Competitive salary * Comprehensive benefits package including our employee discount * Opportunities for professional development and career progression * A dynamic and collaborative work environment focused on innovation and growth **If this sounds like the perfect job for you, please apply now and see what difference you could make!** **Dunnes Stores is an equal opportunity employer** LNKD1\_IJ

The role of the Buyer is to assist clients across the ESB Group in procuring goods and services between €5k-€300k, achieving best value for money, while ensuring compliance with statutory regulations, internal procedures and the code of ethics for the governance of state bodies. **Key Responsibilities** * Manage tenders and quick quote processes including the tender evaluation process in conjunction with the business and in line with ESB Procedures. * Develop close working relationship with internal customers while providing exemplary customer service. * Administering a procurement shared mailbox. * SAP contract management and SAP SRM administration. * Supplier relationship management. * Supplier identification & sourcing. * Identifying areas for process improvement. **Experience And Qualifications** **Essential** * A minimum of 12 months work experience in a business environment. * High levels of commitment, judgement and interpersonal skills are required for the role. * Excellent communication skills. * An excellent working knowledge of MS Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and SharePoint. * If required, the successful candidate must be prepared to undertake a qualification in Procurement. **Desirable** * Experience and knowledge of Procurement * An appropriate third level qualification in Procurement/Supply Chain/ other business studies or equivalent work experience * A willingness to commit to internal and external training as required * A professional qualification in finance, business or procurement is desirable but not essential. **Location** This position will be based in ESB Head Office, 27 Fitzwilliam Street, Dublin 2. *Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate will be required to evidence their right to work in the Republic of Ireland prior to commencement of employment.

title: HGV Driver
description: Join Keelings! You will be part of a passionate team of people, you will grow and develop in our business and truly feel a sense of belonging. At Keelings, we don’t just grow quality fresh produce; we also nurture people and their professional development. The Keeling family always employed the best people for the job, the key to their success was the quality of the people they employed to work for them. That is still the key to our success today. **Keelings Values** * People Matter - We support and treat each other in a clear, fair and respectful way. We all learn, develop and encourage everyone to contribute * Teamwork – We inspire and help each other to deliver our ambitions together as One Keelings * Integrity - We do the right thing and deliver on our commitments * Passion for Achievement - We motivate ourselves and each other to achieve our ambitions with energy, knowledge and courage. We are always striving to be better. **Why join Keelings?** HGV driver, transportation of own and 3rd party product to and from customers premises in a controlled manner and all other aspects relating to transport. All routes are within the isle of Ireland, no trips overseas. There are no overnight stays in cabs, drivers will be planned to finish at the depot. Bay to bay deliveries to all the major retailer distribution depots in Ireland, no tail lift deliveries. All driver CPC’s courses arranged by the company. On site training provided. **Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities** * Driving HGV to deliver our product to own customer sites and collecting 3rd products. * Ensuring POD’s/Delivery dockets are signed and returned in a timely manner. * Dealing with customers on a regular basis and reporting issues back to office. * Complying with customer rules while on their site(s). * Washing both trucks and trailers as required or instructed, including the inside to trailers. * Small repairs and maintenance jobs as required example changing bulbs, steps, checking for oil and water etc. * Adhoc duties, example van driving, shunting trailers and yard work. * Multi drop delivery work on behalf of other Keelings business or associated companies. * Pre-trip and end of day defect reporting. * Securing of pallets and trollies in trailers / trucks so goods arrive at destination in the same order as loaded. * Setting up of temperature of fridge units, monitoring and reporting. **Key Skills & Knowledge** * Good communicator. * Good knowledge of retail deliveries with in Ireland. * Good knowledge of refrigerated transport. * Good team player. **Essential** * Full clean EU cat C / C+E driving licence (UK Licences not covered in ROI). * Up to date digital tachograph card and up to date CPC card. * Minimum 1 years’ experience in driving HGVs. * Experience in the use refrigerated temperature-controlled vehicles / trailers. * Experience in container work. * Required to pass drivers assessment prior to start. * Required to undergo training prior to start. **Desirable** * Experience in yard shunting an advantage but not essential. * Experience in the use refrigerated temperature-controlled vehicles / trailers. * Trained in the use of power pallet trucks and forklifts an advantage. * Mechanical background would be an advantage but not necessary. * Eco driving training an advantage put not necessary. **Specific Requirements** * Flexibility is required to work outside the normal hours to suit the requirements of the business. * Start times and days of work could be changed at short notice (on the day). * Flexibility for days of work. * Work 4 days over 7 days or night no fixed shift pattern. **Recruitment Process** * CV Submission & email acknowledgment of receipt * Phone Screening * 1st Interview * 2nd Interview * Outcome & Feedback **Inclusion & Diversity Statement** In Keelings we value all perspectives and knowledge that our colleagues bring to our business. We are committed to forming a diverse and inclusive team where all can share their unique experiences and perspectives. We welcome applications from all cultures and backgrounds and are dedicated to forming an environment of inclusiveness and diversity where all can thoroughly feel a sense of belonging. **Reasonable Accommodation Statement** If you require reasonable accommodation in submitting your application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the recruitment process, please contact recruitment\_keelings@keelings.com Keelings Careers - https://www.keelings.com/careers-keelings/ Keelings Strategy & Values – https://www.keelings.com/our-people/ INDL

description: With over 20 years of experience in the Nursing Homes Sector, the CareChoice Team is focused on transitioning CareChoice to become the most trusted and respected Nursing Home brand in Ireland. We are now looking for **full time** Hospitality Assistants, for our **Trim** Nursing home. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your skills within a supportive environment whilst working with an experienced team of Healthcare Professionals in a diverse, multi-cultural environment. **Key Responsibilities and Duties:** **Kitchen:** * Ensure kitchen areas are clean. * Adherence to safe storage. * Checking and recording incoming goods to verify quality and quantity. * Compliance with HACCP guidelines. * Rotate where necessary to meet the catering demands of the role as directed. **Housekeeping:** * Daily cleaning of allocated units and general areas within the nursing home. * Assist with keeping the dining area organized, clean and tidy. * Collection and correct disposal of domestic and clinical waste. * Rotate where necessary to meet the housekeeping demands of the role as directed. **Hoisting :** * Prepare the dining rooms for all meals to the high company standards. * Prepare beverage trolleys and trays, make and serve beverages to residents and visitors. * At the end of each meal in the dining rooms clear and re-set tables promptly for the next meal and ensure that the dining room is left clean, tidy and attractively presented. * At the end of the shift, put away all supplies and ensure that stock and materials are secure at all times. * Obtain menus from chef and assist the residents in making their choice for meals. * Ensure that statutory and company requirements in terms of Food Safety, Health & Safety and HACCP are upheld at all times. **What we offer:** * Premium payments on Sundays and night shift * FLYEfit gym discount - stay active and healthy with discounted gym membership * Death in Service Benefit * Comprehensive induction training * A rewarding working environment, with support from supervisors and managers * Competitive rates of pay * Opportunities for promotion within an expanding group * Extensive in-house training (NMBI approved) * Employee Assistance Programme - supporting your mental health and wellbeing * Free parking * Subsidised lunches

title: Humanitarian Fundraiser | Make a Difference in Your Community
description: Would you like your work to make a genuine difference? ***Opportunities Available Across Ireland*** **Imagine finishing your day knowing that the conversations you've had could help provide life-saving medical care to people who need it most.** At **CPM Ireland** , we're looking for **friendly, people-focused individuals** to join our team as **Humanitarian Fundraisers** representing **Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) / Doctors Without Borders** . If you enjoy connecting with others and are looking for a role with purpose, we'd love to hear from you. **Why People Love This Role** * €27,000 Base Salary (Full-Time) * Uncapped Commission (€39,000+ OTE) * €7 Daily Lunch Allowance * Mileage Allowance * Fully Paid Training * Full-Time & Part-Time Opportunities * 30 Paid Days Off Per Year (Full-Time Employees) * Supportive Team Environment * The Opportunity to Make a Genuine Difference About MSF Every day, **MSF** teams provide emergency medical care to people affected by conflict, disease outbreaks, natural disasters, and humanitarian crises around the world. The support of everyday donors helps make this vital work possible, ensuring that medical teams can continue reaching people when they need it most. About the Role As an **MSF Humanitarian Fundraiser** , you'll speak with people in your local community, share the incredible work of MSF, and give them the opportunity to support a cause that saves lives every day. If you're looking for a rewarding role where you can connect with people, make a genuine difference, and be proud of what you do every day, we'd love to hear from you. **Requirements** ***Please note* ***:*** *A full driving licence and access to your own vehicle are essential for this role.*** **Benefits** What We Offer * Friendly and supportive team environment * Meaningful work that helps support life-saving humanitarian aid * €7 daily lunch allowance * Mileage allowance and travel support * Fully paid training from day one * Ongoing support to help you succeed * Opportunities to learn, grow, and develop * Regular team events and social activities

title: Intern Software Engineer (C++)
description: **Software Engineer Intern (C++) - Nitro** At Nitro, we’re looking for motivated students who are currently pursuing undergraduate or graduate degrees and have a strong interest in the technology sector. As a paid intern, you’ll be a valued part of the team from day one—no coffee runs or making copies. You’ll take on meaningful projects that impact our business, attend meetings, share your insights. Our internship program is designed to help you explore career opportunities, build valuable skills, and grow both personally and professionally. Work alongside a supportive and dynamic team to see what being part of Nitro is all about. **Join Nitro's Engineering Team** The Engineering Team at Nitro is responsible for building high-performance, scalable solutions that drive our product innovation. We are now looking for a Software Engineer Intern (C++) to support our team in developing and optimising software solutions. In this role, you will collaborate closely with our engineers and cross-functional teams to contribute to the design, development, and improvement of key systems. **What You’ll Do** * Assist in developing and optimising C++ applications. * Collaborate with engineering, product, and design teams to build and improve features. * Help debug, test, and ensure the performance of existing software solutions. * Contribute to code reviews, ensuring best practices and clean, maintainable code. * Support the development of new functionalities based on product requirements. **What We’re Looking For** * Strong interest in software engineering and C++ development. * Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. * Ability to work well in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment. * Familiarity with object-oriented programming and version control systems (e.g., Git). * Basic knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and system design principles. **About You** You're not just bright, you shine! Your intellect and energy make you stand out. Whether it’s problem-solving, sparking curiosity, or coming up with creative solutions, you always get the job done. Even as a current undergrad or grad student, you’re ready to make an impact in the global marketplace. You want to join an agile, innovative team that values your input and is dedicated to helping you grow. Welcome to **Nitro** . *Nitro strongly encourages applications from everyone regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. We provide an accessible candidate experience and invite you to request any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond.*

title: Junior Accountant
description: **Department:** Finance & Operations **Employment Type:** Full Time **Location:** Ireland **Description** Emergn is a technology and management consultancy with a mission to set our clients free. No dependency. No short-term fix. Just teaching them the real cure to their problems, so they can stay ahead of their competitors now and forever. A different kind of consultancy like this needs a different kind of team. One you might be just the right fit for. This is a place for people who want to: **– Make a real difference.** Here, you solve problems for real. No endless engagements or running up the clock. You get to see how change really works for some of the world’s greatest businesses. **– Never stop growing** . We turn our expertise back on ourselves. Here, you’re always learning, stretching your thinking at the cutting edge of how organizations grow, which means staying at the cutting edge of your own growth too. **– Belong everywhere** . We’re a global community of experts who work without borders. Friendly, supportive, and genuinely collaborative. Because when you’re trying to change an industry, you need people who have each other’s backs. As a **Junior Accountant** at Emergn you will deliver consistent product quality and reliability. Join our team and let’s change the game together! We want you to: * Support day-to-day bookkeeping, including accounts payable and receivable. * Perform bank reconciliations and assist with resolving discrepancies. * Support month-end close, including journals, accruals, and reconciliations. * Assist with statutory accounts preparation under the guidance of senior finance team members. * Support intercompany transactions and reconciliation. * Assist with VAT compliance and other routine finance activities. * Provide support during internal and external audits. * Maintain accurate financial records and support the wider Finance team with ad hoc tasks. This job might be for you if you have: * 2+ years of previous financial & management accounting experience. * Part-qualified or studying towards ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent qualification. * Strong attention to detail and a structured, organised approach to work. * Good analytical and problem-solving skills. * Willingness to learn and develop within an international, multi-entity environment. * Experience with intercompany transactions, VAT, or audit support would be an advantage. * Experience working in a global company. * Strong analytical & problem-solving skills. * Advanced Excel skills. * Excellent spoken English. **You might also have:** * Experience working for a company with a global delivery model * Knowledge of tax, accounting & regulations for different countries * Worked with a remote team (our Finance team is spread across our locations) What we offer: * Work within a dynamic international team of experts. * Excellent opportunity for personal and professional development. * Flexible work model and the freedom to choose the tools that suit you best – Mac or Windows. * Ability to work with modern technologies. * Extensive catalogue of educational programs, the possibility of training and certification at the expense of the company. * Health and life insurance. * 25 days annual leave. * Medical and Dental benefits. * Birthday gift. * Travel insurance.

title: Junior Field IT Support (Dublin, Ireland)
description: **Job Summary** **JOB DESCRIPTION – Junior Field IT Support** Location:Dublin (Onsite) Division: Ticketmaster UK/IRE – Enterprise Support Contract Terms: Permanent, 40 hours per week **THE TEAM** The Technology Support team which is part of the Global Support & Operations organisation, is a customer focused service delivery team providing technical support and installations services across the various business units and client base. We are a key department responsible for the successful delivery of major events and festivals as well as ensuring the ongoing support and maintenance of our fixed client base and owned and operated venues. Focused on providing high levels of customer and client satisfaction we are driven to provide safe, secure and reliable solutions and services that enables fans to enjoy the experience of live events. **THE JOB** The Technology Support team will focus their day to day by providing support to our clients and the wider Ticketmaster and Livenation business either remotely or in person. Supporting a wide range of products, peripherals and Ticketmaster proprietary software you will need to be technically focused and customer centric. The Technical Support team will often work in the pressurised but enjoyable environment of festivals and outdoor events installing a wide range of hardware and software solutions that provides fans with a seamless and enjoyable experience attending Live events. **What You Will Do** * Installation and support of Ticketmaster proprietary software and hardware e.g. Ticket printers, Handheld Devices and Point of Sale * Installation of software, firmware to ensure devices are up to date * Installing and supporting network devices including Wireless Access Points, Switches, Bridges etc * Upgrading and replacing hardware and software as and when required * Configuring and testing of the above said hardware and software * Diagnosing and remediation of issues and problems both remotely and on-site * Raising incidents and updating incident management software * Tracking Assets and updating asset management software * Minimise incidents and service distribution by providing proactive support and maintenance * Coordinating and liaising with clients prior to attendance and installations * Working with third party providers and contractors often in a lead capacity * Provide on-site end user training and demonstration of Ticketmaster products * Updating and maintaining technical and operational documentation * Communicating and collaborating with multiple teams and clients * Following best practices and procedures ensuring standards are maintained * Maintain an understanding of all TM and LN products usage and functionality **What You Need To Know** * A willingness or keen interest or knowledge of Microsoft, and mobile device applications. * An interest in learning wired and wireless networking technologies and products * Eager to expand knowledge within the entertainment business and its requirements to meet our client’s needs, be committed to your development within the Junior support role. **YOU** * An aptitude for understanding concepts and methodologies, both technical and non-technical * Good interpersonal and communication skills – Fluent English essential * Candidate must be detail oriented and organised * Ability to travel required * May be required to work nights, weekends, or holidays * Must have valid clean driving licence * Candidate must be dynamic to meet the needs of an ever-changing live entertainment environment **TICKETMASTER VALUES** * Reliability – We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen. * Teamwork - – We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team * Integrity – We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent * Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive **EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES** We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and home life. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It’s talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities. **CULTURE** We’re fans who help fans everywhere get in to the live events they love. A proud division of Live Nation Entertainment, Ticketmaster has changed the way the world connects with their favourite artists, teams, and shows, and we continue to shape innovation every day. We’re not just selling tickets (though we do that better than anyone else), we’re enriching lives one amazing experience at a time. And we think that’s pretty amazing. If you’re passionate about the magic of live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you. We have a ‘Fan First’ mindset, placing customers at the heart of everything we do. Whether working behind the scenes or engaging directly with the ‘Fan’ you will be part of a culture that supports and enriches the fan experience. Your work, our passion… delivering world class experiences – Fan First. Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

title: Kerry Internship Programme 2027 - ICT
description: 📍 **Key Internship Details** **Where** Naas, Ireland **Start date** Between January and March 2027 **Duration** 6-12 months **Working model** Full-time hybrid, with 3 days per week in the office 🌱 **Grow Your Future at Kerry** At Kerry, our purpose - **Inspiring Food, Nourishing Life** - comes to life through science, innovation and **sustainable nutrition** . From food and beverage to pharma, our teams use insight, technology and science-backed solutions to help solve real-world challenges for people, society and the planet. Our impact reaches billions, but it starts with curious people, fresh ideas and teams who care about making a difference. If you’re looking for a place to learn, contribute and build real experience with purpose, Kerry could be the place for you. 🚀 **Our Internship Programme Your First Step into Kerry** Our internships give you a real introduction to Kerry - our people, our work and the impact we’re creating through sustainable nutrition. With opportunities across **Ireland, the UK and Mainland Europe** , you’ll have time to learn, contribute and get a feel for where your career could go next. Demonstrate your potential during your internship and your application for our Graduate Programme will be fast-tracked. 📊 **What You’ll Work On** As an **ICT Intern** based in **Naas** , you’ll join Kerry’s global ICT team, supporting business transformation projects that help our teams work smarter, faster and more effectively. You’ll be part of a fast-paced, collaborative environment where innovation, teamwork and practical problem-solving are at the centre of what we do. * Getting involved in global business transformation projects and seeing how digital solutions are developed, supported and implemented across Kerry. * Supporting and enhancing a range of business applications, from data capture through to analysis, reporting and presentation tools. * Depending on business needs and your interests, you could be placed in one of our specialist ICT teams, with opportunities across business systems, digital operations, data, service delivery and infrastructure — including Back Office, Front Office, Master Data Governance, Data Conversion, Service Delivery, Middle Office and Infrastructure. * Working closely with colleagues across the business, including Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain and Procurement, to understand how ICT supports Kerry’s day-to-day operations and long-term goals. * Building your functional skills and technical knowledge through on-the-job learning, external training and exposure to real ICT priorities. 🔎 **What We’re Looking For** You don’t need to have it all figured out. For this internship, we’re looking for someone who is curious, organised and ready to get involved. * Studying Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related degree, and on track for a 21 degree classification (or equivalent). * Curious about how a global business works, and open to learning from the people around you. * Comfortable taking ownership of your work, while knowing when to ask questions or reach out for support. * Eager to explore AI and new technologies, and keen to use them to work smarter, solve real challenges and make a meaningful impact. * Confident using Microsoft Office, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook and Teams, and Copilot. * Clear in how you communicate, whether you’re working with your team, sharing updates or managing priorities. 🌟 **What’s in It for You** * Annual salary €29,500, pro-rated based on the duration of the internship. * See the bigger picture real experience that helps you understand Kerry, our work in sustainable nutrition and how our people bring our purpose to life. * Build your network opportunities to connect with other interns, graduates and colleagues across Kerry. * Share your impact work on a project during your internship and present your contribution at the end of the programme. * Keep growing make a strong impact during your internship, and your application for our Graduate Programme will be fast-tracked. 📝 **Ready to Take the First Step? Apply Now!** If this sounds like the kind of start you’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you. After you apply, candidates who meet the requirements will be invited to complete a psychometric assessment. If successful, you’ll then be invited to a 30-minute virtual interview. * Please note Applicants must have the right to work full-time in the Country they are applying for.

title: Kitchen Assistant - Neon Asian Street Food, Camden St, Dublin 2
description: Job Description Neon Asian Street Food is a Thai restaurant located in Dublin 2 where our goal is to deliver good quality food with no fuss, in a relaxed and informal environment. Fresh ingredients and quality product are prepared every day by a team of skilled Thai Chefs to produce authentic Asian street food. We are currently looking to recruit Kitchen Assistants to join our kitchen team. with full-time opportunities available. Suitable candidates should have some experience of working in a similar environment / operation, be motivated, have excellent customer care skills, be confident communicators and have a passion for helping people. As a kitchen assistant, you should be willing to learn and develop yourself, have a desire to succeed and to contribute to our positive team environment as well as promoting our unique brand. A passion for food, with a genuine interest and desire to expand their food knowledge is also preferable. Kitchen Assistants will have the following responsibilities: * Work as part of the team to provide the highest standard of food preparation quality and presentation. * To ensure the regular and systematic cleaning and maintenance of all areas of the kitchen and equipment are kept clean and hygienic at all times, whilst ensuring that hygiene and food safety standards are adhered to. * Washing utensils and dishes and making sure they are stored appropriately. * Sorting, storing and distributing ingredients. * Washing, peeling, chopping, cutting and cooking food and helping to prepare the products for distribution. * Disposing of rubbish. * To adhere to specifications, standards and procedures while at work * Provide a fast, friendly and efficient level of customer service. Then apply now and see what difference you could make. LNKD1\_IJ

title: Laboratory Analyst
description: **We are SGS – the world’s leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 97,000 employees operate a network of 2,650 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.** **Job Description** **ROLE OVERVIEW** * **Job Title** : Laboratory Analyst * **Job Type:** Permanent * **Location:** Unit 1C N11 South Point Business Park, Charvey Lane,, Rathnew, Ireland * **Hours:** 39 hours p/w * **Salary:** €35000-52000 pa **Main Purpose of Role** The primary function of this role is to work in the Gas Chromatography laboratory in Rathnew. This includes testing of gas samples using SGS GAS and Pharmacopeia procedures, develop SGS GAS procedures for new & existing GC testing methods and compile reports for the testing. In this role you will work to cGMP standards and complete work under GAS ISO17025 accreditation. You will also complete validation testing for new equipment and methods being brought into service under direction and support from the laboratory manager or technical manager. You will develop a knowledge and competence of Gas Chromatography using TCD, FID, PDHID, DID, SCD, MS, and other detection technologies and must have the willingness to learn. Full training will be provided from our offices in Ireland and by external vendors when necessary. You will work with a team of passionate hands-on engineers, scientists, and other departments of SGS GAS such as the quality team and the field-testing team. You will also work with the wider SGS group. Good communication skills are required. You must be self-motivated with a “can-do” attitude and be customer focused. **Primary Responsibilities** * Work independently and provide guidance and role modelling for Junior staff. * Focus on customer requirements and prioritise workload in the GC lab. * Run the operation meeting for gas testing and instrumentation reports. * Role model clean as you go policy in the GC laboratory and act of the area owner. * Perform a variety of routine sample testing to quantitatively measure gas quality in a variety of products and for different applications. * Execute validated analytical methods with minimal supervision. * Analyse, compile and format results of testing into clear reports for lab and field-testing work in a timely manner. * Prepare GCs for testing and complete system suitability testing. * Assist in development and validation of new basic and complex analysis for GC-TCD/FID/MS/SCD/DID/ECD under supervision. * Problem-solve basic and complex GC technical issues and utilise internal and external expertise to identify and address problems with the minimum impact. * Report issues to the quality department and take part in the relevant investigations. * Comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), ISO17025 requirements and all internal processes. * Participate in internal and external laboratory audits under the direction of the SGS-GAS quality manager. * Be willing and able to work as a team member to ensure continuous improvement relative to laboratory functions. * Adhere to all safety protocols. * Be available for occasional weekend work (short shifts – 2 to 4 hours). * On rare occasions travel to customer sites to complete testing and/or technical meetings and reviews. * Complete project work within the SGS laboratory network and SGS customers – potentially on another site for a defined duration. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in science. With 2 years minimum experience in analytical chemistry & Gas Chromatography techniques. **Additional Information** The ideal candidate should possess the following attributes/skillsets * Lead by example in promoting a Health & Safety culture. * Strong attention to detail. * Analytical decision maker. * Be dependable and reliable and able to work in a process driven environment. * To be organised, self-motivated and able to prioritise and manage conflicting needs of the business. * High level of computer literacy. * You should be a strong communicator and have the ability to negotiate both internally and externally with, contractors, customers and colleagues.

title: Refrigeration Engineer
description: The role: Their engineers primarily work on specialist laboratory and medical refrigeration equipment rather than supermarket, industrial or domestic refrigeration systems. This generally means working in clean, professional environments such as hospitals, laboratories and pharmaceutical facilities. The role also offers a more predictable working pattern than many areas of the refrigeration industry: - Predominantly Monday to Friday daytime work. - No shift work. - No routine overnight supermarket refrigeration work. - Limited out-of-hours requirements. - Occasional weekend cover as required. - Travel throughout Ireland and Northern Ireland, with occasional overnight stays.
