Duties and Responsibilities: Working alongside our experienced refrigeration engineers, you will: - Carry out installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of refrigeration equipment. - Complete routine preventive maintenance and service work on laboratory and medical refrigeration equipment. - Diagnose refrigeration, electrical and control-related faults. - Assist with commissioning and testing of new equipment. - Travel to customer sites throughout Ireland and Northern Ireland. - Work directly with customers in hospitals, laboratories, pharmaceutical facilities and other regulated environments. - Develop your knowledge of specialist laboratory refrigeration and associated control systems. - Troubleshoot equipment software and controls and carry out firmware updates where required. - Complete service documentation and reports accurately and to a high standard. - Provide technical support and basic equipment training to customers as your knowledge and experience develop. - Work with the wider company Service and Sales teams to identify opportunities to support customers with replacement equipment, upgrades and additional services. Training and Development: - The company will support the successful candidate in continuing and completing their refrigeration and air conditioning apprenticeship. - In addition to their formal apprenticeship training, the successful candidate will receive: - Hands-on mentoring from experienced refrigeration engineers. - Training on specialist laboratory and medical refrigeration equipment. - Exposure to a wide variety of equipment, manufacturers and technologies. - Opportunities to attend relevant manufacturer training, workshops and technical courses. - Increasing responsibility and independence as their skills and experience develop. - The opportunity to build a long-term career within the company's growing technical service team. Requirements Essential: - Currently undertaking a recognised Refrigeration and Air Conditioning apprenticeship, with candidates in the later stages of their apprenticeship particularly encouraged to apply. - Previous practical experience carrying out refrigeration service, maintenance or installation work. - Full clean EU driving licence. - Good understanding of refrigeration systems and fault-finding principles. **Desired Skills and Experience** HVAC, Refrigeration, Mechanical, Electrical, Repair, Diagnose, Install Adecco Ireland is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS DMS
description: **Description** AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) has migrated more than 1.5 million database workloads to AWS, helping enterprises move from commercial databases (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2) to open-source Amazon Aurora and RDS (PostgreSQL, MySQL). The service is used by customers across the world to migrate their most important data from their on-premises datacenters to Amazon services. Our customers depend on our services' reliability and security to handle their business data. More information on AWS DMS is available at http://aws.amazon.com/dms. As an SDE2 on the DMS team, you will work directly on the core C/C++ replication engine that powers heterogeneous database migrations for tens of thousands of customers running large-scale production fleets. You'll focus on the PostgreSQL, Oracle, and SQL Server endpoints - the highest-volume migration paths driving Aurora and RDS growth. Your work will directly impact migration reliability, security compliance, and the experience of customers migrating their most critical production databases to AWS. AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. Key job responsibilities Design, implement, and ship fixes and features in the C/C++ replication engine for PostgreSQL, Oracle, and SQL Server source/target endpoints. Diagnose and resolve complex production issues - task crashes, memory corruption, CDC failures, data validation errors - using core dump analysis, memory profilers (AddressSanitizer, Valgrind), and systematic debugging. Develop and expand automated test coverage using the Scalable Test Platform (STP), including combinatorial testing scenarios that exercise millions of parameter combinations across migration paths. Deliver security fixes within SLA and contribute to security compliance initiatives including vulnerability remediation, credential exposure prevention, and secure supply chain builds. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and release management for our deployment cadence serving hundreds of thousands of production instances. Collaborate with Database Engineers to reproduce and fix customer-reported issues, translating ambiguous production failures into root causes and verified fixes. Leverage and contribute to AI-powered engineering tools (Meshclaw autonomous bug-fixing, Kiro-based on-call agent) to accelerate defect detection and resolution. Participate in on-call rotation, triaging production incidents and driving them to resolution. A day in the life You might start the day investigating a crash signature affecting thousands of customer tasks - analyzing the core dump, identifying a use-after-free in a CDC thread shutdown path, and writing a fix with a coordinated shutdown mechanism. After code review, you write an automated test that reproduces the race condition under concurrent load. In the afternoon, you're working on a security fix, ensuring the remediation doesn't regress existing customer behavior. You end the day reviewing a CR from a teammate fixing a PostgreSQL logical decoding edge case, and updating the crash classifier with a new signature your fix will eliminate. **About The Team** Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future. The DMS engine team operates across Dublin, Poland, and the US. We're a team that takes ownership of a complex system and makes it better every release -reducing crashes, closing security gaps, and making migrations reliable enough that customers don't need our help to succeed. We leverage AI extensively: from autonomous bug-fixing to an on-call agent that cuts troubleshooting time dramatically. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. **Basic Qualifications** * Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience in embedded development in C/C++ **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with database replication technologies: CDC (Change Data Capture), logical replication, log-based capture (LogMiner, fn\_dblog, pgoutput) * Experience with security vulnerability remediation in production systems * Experience building automated test frameworks or improving test coverage for complex systems * Experience with memory safety tooling (AddressSanitizer, ThreadSanitizer, Helgrind) * Experience operating services at scale (multi-region deployments, large customer fleets) * Experience with release management and deployment pipelines for large fleets Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. title: Telco NOC Specialist (Europe)
description: **Company Overview** Holafly is a high-growth scale-up revolutionising how businesses and travellers connect to the internet abroad. With a team of 600+ professionals across multiple countries, we are scaling globally to support travellers with seamless, unlimited data connectivity. We’re not just connecting people—we’re enabling freedom and peace of mind, ensuring our users stay connected from the second they land, wherever their journey takes them. The Role As our NOC / L1 Support Specilist, you will be the first line of defense in ensuring global connectivity by monitoring our MVNE platform and resolving roaming technicalities. Your work directly impacts our brand promise of uninterrupted data, ensuring every traveler stays online regardless of their destination. Key Responsibilities * Monitor and maintain service availability across our global networks using platforms like Zabbix to identify and resolve technical anomalies. * Diagnose and troubleshoot complex eSIM and roaming registration flows to ensure rapid restoration of traveler connectivity. * Manage the SIM lifecycle, from APN configurations to IMSI/ICCID validation, ensuring seamless activation for all users. * Collaborate across teams, acting as the technical bridge between Customer Service and L2 engineering to escalate critical incidents effectively. * Document operational processes and technical workflows to build a robust knowledge base that scales with our rapid growth. * Drive service quality by tracking performance indicators and proactively identifying potential connectivity bottlenecks before they affect users. **Qualifications** * Professional experience in a NOC, Technical Support, or Telecommunications operational environment. * Foundational knowledge of mobile network elements (4G/5G) and roaming concepts like HSS, PGW, and APN settings. * Technical curiosity for eSIM technologies, including activation flows and SM-DP+ basics. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders. * Adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, "brave" scale-up environment where quick learning is essential. **Nice-to-haves** * Basic understanding of Diameter (ULR/ULA) or MAP/SS7 protocols. * Experience with Jira or similar enterprise ticketing systems. Our passion for providing easy and convenient connectivity to travellers around the world drives everything we do. We love our work and we do it with pride. Stay connected wherever you go.

The key responsibilities of the Project Engineer role are described below. * **Proposal & Contract Stage** * Discuss the enquiry with the Engineering Manager, or appointed delegate, or Client in order to determine key criteria such as final water quality specification; preferred purification technologies; scope of supply; contract budget and timeframe. * Prepare and submit Design and Commercial Proposals to clients and follow-up as necessary to secure a Purchase Order. * Obtain the contract of acceptance in writing from the client and acknowledge receipt of the order. * Attend “hand-over” meetings from Sales to Contracts to identify and understand the conditions of contract and ensure that the Purchase Order reflects the scope of the work. * Conduct Design Reviews to check that the sales design complies with the contract requirements, procurement budgets and installation method statements before it is adopted. Check through the water analysis, the mechanical / hydraulic and electrical engineering design requirements of the proposed system. * Establish an accurate personnel administration and record system and maintain these in compliance with QA procedures. * Produce a contract programme, schedule and other administrative documents for each contract and issue these to the relevant people, ensuring that the contract programme is on schedule at all times and the conditions of contract adhered to. * Monitor progress, prepare progress reports and attend weekly progress meetings. * Ensure that all potential variations are identified, quantified and agreed with the clients’ agents in accordance with the contract procedure. * Obtain appropriate assistance and input from other people / departments in a timely manner so as to meet the contract requirements. * Advise the Engineering Manager, or appointed delegate, of the technical standards and specifications of the contract and include these with the procurement documents. * Prepare a “hand-over” pack for the Service Department and schedule system commissioning. * Project-manage all contracts assigned until hand-over to the client. * Carry-out a post contract meeting with the Engineering Manager, or appointed delegate, and other departments with a view to improving contract performance. * **Finance** * Prepare and ensure completion and “sign-off” of Proposal Design Sheets and Cost Sheets. * Review the cost sheet and necessary resources for successful completion of the contract. * Prepare a Cost Sheet for each contract with prior agreement from the Finance Director and Engineering Manager, or appointed delegate. * Agree the Cost Sheet and progress valuations with the client and liaise with the Finance Director to ensure that payment is being made by the client in accordance with the schedule. * Procure cost-effective equipment in compliance with the agreed project programme, terms and conditions and client specification and ensure that goods and services are available on time. * Monitor the contract for Scope, Time and Budget variations and generate a Variations Engineering Cost Sheet for approval and signature by the client before work commences. * Prepare cost spreadsheets to determine the contract value and margin. Monitor, maintain and improve the contract margin where possible without compromising technical quality or standards. * Submit Contract Management Reports monthly to the Engineering Manager, or appointed delegate, indicating margin position. * **Customer Liaison** * Represent the Company on all matters relating to the contract and control all related correspondence and documentation. * Carry out all client communications politely, professionally and courteously, promoting good relations and efficiency and delivering a professional approach at all times. * Plan all site operations with the relevant organisations briefed in the technical, safety and timescale requirements of the contract. * Attend site meetings with the Client, Engineering Consultant and Sub-contractor when required and issue the relevant follow-up minutes. * Ensure that standard and special systems Operating Handbooks are issued to the client in accordance with the contract timeframe and, where appropriate in larger systems, ensure that clients receive a thorough operating training. * **Health & Safety** * Be aware and familiar with the risks associated with particular industries before visiting a site and request from the client details of known health and safety hazards and follow any instructions given, acting in a responsible and aware manner, avoiding undue risks. * Comply with all health and safety requirements when dealing with suppliers and sub-contractors. * Adhere to all Company and client safety and health regulations and employee obligations. **Qualifications** Third level qualification in Mechanical Engineering **Additional Information** About Veolia Group Join a global environmental pioneer with 218,000+ employees worldwide. At Veolia, we're leading the ecological transformation through innovative solutions in water, waste, and energy management. Our impact? Creating a sustainable future for generations to come. We offer you the opportunity to join a Group whose goal is to become the benchmark company for ecological transformation! What are the advantages of joining us? * Be part of a forward-thinking collaborative team who will focus on your future career and development both locally and internationally * Possibility to be part of exciting projects outside of your daily work/ scope for your company * We are committed to ensure you have the best experience possible * Veolia is committed to a global social pact for its employees in all its geographic regions. But also: * Flexible working * Competitive pension * Health Insurance * Opportunities for growth and development Here at Veolia Water Technologies, we know that some applicants don't apply unless they think they tick all the boxes - but we are saying don't worry! We would much rather see your application than risk missing out on your potential! **As an inclusive company, Veolia is committed to diversity and gives equal consideration to all applications, without discrimination.**

title: Graduate Traffic Engineer - Dublin (2027 start)
description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. As one of the largest dedicated Traffic Engineering teams in the UK&I, we work on a diverse range of projects focused on creating safer, more efficient and sustainable transport networks for communities. Our work covers the development and appraisal of practical solutions for pedestrians, cyclists and vehicles, including road and street design, traffic signals, cycle facilities, traffic management and traffic modelling. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers and other technical professionals in multidisciplinary teams to develop innovative, cost-effective solutions for our clients. Projects range from concept and preliminary design through to modelling, detailed design and implementation, giving you the opportunity to gain experience across the full project lifecycle. You’ll also develop your understanding of digital engineering and BIM processes. As your experience and confidence grow, you’ll take on increasing responsibility for project tasks and technical deliverables, with opportunities to contribute to projects from inception through to completion. You may gain experience across a variety of projects, including: * Road and street design * Junction and intersection design * Cycle lane and active travel design * Bus priority and Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) schemes * Streetscape and urban improvement projects * Traffic management planning and design * Traffic signal design * Traffic signage and road markings * Traffic modelling and microsimulation * Traffic impact assessments and transport assessments * Network analysis and optimisation * Feasibility studies and scheme development * Road safety assessments and audits Our Traffic Engineering graduates also have opportunities to work alongside our Highways teams on major highways projects. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM. **Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity** You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed. You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients. AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too. Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours. title: ICT Infrastructure Analyst
description: Job Purpose To provide effective, secure ICT support services to our Ireland users and business functions. The ICT Analyst delivers frontline, Level 1 and Level 2 technical support; administers on-premises and cloud services; supports Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Entra ID; maintains ICT infrastructure and end-user computing services; and contributes to cybersecurity, service improvement and ICT projects. The role operates within approved governance frameworks, time, quality and budget requirements. Scope of the Role The role is a broad enterprise ICT support and administration position spanning user-facing support, service desk operations, endpoint services, Microsoft platforms, on-premises infrastructure, identity and access management, networking, cybersecurity, technical documentation, supplier liaison and project delivery. The postholder is expected to resolve issues at the appropriate support level, escalate effectively, protect service continuity and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Main Duties and Responsibilities Frontline User Support, Service Desk and Level 1 Support * Act as a professional first point of contact for ICT incidents, service requests, access requests and user queries received by telephone, portal, email, Teams, walk-up or other approved channels. * Log, categorise, prioritise, own and progress tickets in the approved service management platform, maintaining clear and timely records throughout the ticket lifecycle. * Provide Level 1 diagnosis and resolution for common hardware, software, account, printing, connectivity, collaboration, telephony, mobile device and peripheral issues. * Support users at our Ireland locations and remote workers through approved remote-support tools and onsite assistance. * Provide clear user guidance for Microsoft 365 applications, Windows, browsers, business applications and approved mobile services. * Perform password resets, account unlocks, MFA registration support and standard access remediation in accordance with approved identity verification and access procedures. * Prepare, deploy, replace, recover and troubleshoot laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, headsets, mobile devices and associated peripherals. * Maintain ownership of assigned incidents and requests, keep users informed, meet applicable service targets and confirm satisfactory resolution before closure. * Identify recurring incidents, knowledge gaps and training needs, and contribute solutions, knowledge articles and user communications. Level 2 Technical Support and Escalation * Undertake advanced diagnosis and resolution of incidents escalated from Level 1 support or identified through monitoring and operational activity. * Troubleshoot Windows, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Entra ID, endpoint, network, authentication, application and infrastructure issues using appropriate technical and administrative tools. * Analyse logs, alerts, configuration, performance and dependency information to identify root cause or determine the most effective escalation route. * Coordinate with internal technical specialists, system owners, cybersecurity personnel, application teams and external suppliers where third-line or specialist intervention is required. * Create technically complete escalations that include business impact, troubleshooting performed, evidence, timestamps, affected services and current workaround status. * Contribute to problem management, root cause analysis, known-error records, post-incident reviews and permanent corrective actions. * Provide planned out-of-hours, on-call or weekend support where required by operational arrangements. Microsoft 365 Applications and Tenant Administration * Administer and support the Microsoft 365 tenant and associated services in accordance with approved roles, policies and change controls. * Provide administration and Level 1/Level 2 support for Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Apps and related services. * Support mailbox, distribution list, shared mailbox, Teams, SharePoint site, OneDrive, permissions, sharing and collaboration issues. * Monitor Microsoft 365 service health and operational alerts, assess user impact and communicate or escalate appropriately. * Assist with tenant configuration, feature deployment, update readiness, licensing allocation, licence optimisation and service adoption. * Support approved governance controls for guest access, external sharing, application consent, retention, information protection and collaboration. * Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and approved automation tools to improve administration, reporting and repeatability where appropriate. * Create and maintain tenant configuration records, standard operating procedures, support documentation and evidence required for audit or review. Microsoft Entra ID, Identity and Access Management * Administer users, groups, enterprise applications, service principals and assigned administrative roles in Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity services. * Support the joiner, mover and leaver lifecycle, ensuring identity and access changes are authorised, accurate, timely and traceable. * Administer and troubleshoot authentication, single sign-on, MFA, self-service password reset, device identity and access issues. * Support implementation, testing and monitoring of Conditional Access policies under approved governance and change control. * Administer user access rights and role assignments associated with RBAC, privileged access and identity governance standards. * Support identity governance activities including access reviews, entitlement reviews, inactive account review and privileged access monitoring. * Monitor identity-related alerts, risky sign-ins and suspicious authentication activity, and escalate or respond in accordance with incident procedures. * Maintain emergency access, administrative account and service account controls in accordance with approved standards. Azure and Cloud Platform Support * Provide operational support for Microsoft Azure services within the responsibilities assigned to the ICT function. * Assist with Azure subscription, resource group, access, policy, monitoring, tagging, cost-awareness and governance activities. * Support Azure-hosted virtual machines, storage, networking, backup, monitoring and related services where deployed. * Apply approved RBAC, security, logging, backup, resilience and configuration standards to cloud resources. * Participate in cloud migrations, service onboarding, technical assurance and operational handover activities. * Investigate cloud service incidents and coordinate escalation to service owners, suppliers or Microsoft support where required. On-Premises Infrastructure and Core Services * Administer and support day to day operation of assigned infrastructure including Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate, file, print and related infrastructure services within delegated authority and documented procedures. * Support hybrid integration between on-premises Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including identity synchronisation and authentication dependencies. * Perform user, group, computer, shared resource and permissions administration in accordance with approved access controls. * Support server, storage, virtualisation and backup platforms, including monitoring, routine checks, restore requests and incident resolution. * Apply approved security hardening, anti-malware, encryption, patching and configuration standards to desktop and server platforms. * Support business continuity, disaster recovery, backup validation, technical recovery testing and service restoration activities. * Maintain accurate configuration, asset, warranty, location, ownership and lifecycle records for ICT equipment and systems. Endpoint, Application and Device Management * Build, configure, deploy and support Windows endpoints and approved applications using current enterprise management tools. * Administer endpoint compliance, configuration profiles, software deployment, update management and security controls through Microsoft Intune, KACE or other approved platforms. * Support iPhone, iPad and other approved mobile devices, mobile applications and access controls. * Diagnose application installation, compatibility, performance, licensing and user-profile issues. * Coordinate application packaging, testing, deployment and rollback activities in accordance with change and release controls. * Support asset discovery, software inventory, licence tracking and device lifecycle processes. Network, Connectivity and Communications Support * Support LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, firewall, switch, router, proxy, internet, remote access and network monitoring services within delegated authority. * Troubleshoot user and site connectivity issues and gather appropriate evidence before escalation. * Support network access controls, secure remote access, IP addressing, DNS resolution, cabling and associated endpoint connectivity. * Monitor network availability, capacity and alerts and assist with incident investigation and service restoration. * Support voice, video, Teams meeting-room, telephony and conferencing services where assigned. Cybersecurity, Data Protection and Compliance * Apply security policy, secure configuration standards and approved controls across endpoints, identities, applications, networks and infrastructure. * Perform first line investigation and triage of security alerts and suspected incidents and escalate matters requiring specialist security analysis in accordance with the incident response process. * Support Microsoft Defender, endpoint protection, email security, vulnerability remediation, patch compliance and security monitoring activities where assigned. * Support Microsoft Purview capabilities including sensitivity labels, information protection, DLP, retention and data governance where implemented. * Protect confidentiality, integrity and availability of company information and handle personal, operational and security information appropriately. * Provide evidence and technical support for audits, risk assessments, vulnerability reviews, compliance exercises and control assurance activities. * Promote secure user behaviour and support delivery of security awareness and technology guidance. Service Management, Change and Documentation * Work in accordance with approved incident, request, problem, change, release, configuration, knowledge and asset management processes. * Assess business impact and urgency when prioritising work, with particular awareness of Ireland operational and safety-related environments. * Prepare and maintain accurate support procedures, system records, diagrams, configuration documentation, knowledge articles and handover material. * Participate in planned changes, maintenance windows and service reviews, ensuring testing, communication, rollback and evidence requirements are addressed. * Produce service reports, support metrics and technical information as requested, and use trend information to identify improvements. * Handle records in accordance with applicable retention, security, data protection and records-management requirements. Projects, Continuous Improvement and Suppliers * Participate in ICT projects and service improvement initiatives by providing technical input, testing, and implementation support, documentation and operational handover. * Work with business and process owners to define technical needs, deliverables, dependencies, risks and acceptance criteria. * Provide realistic work estimates, implementation plans, risk inputs and progress updates for assigned activities. * Evaluate new technologies and recommend practical improvements that strengthen service, resilience, security, usability or cost effectiveness. * Assist with procurement specifications, technical evaluation, licensing, renewals, hardware and software acquisition. * Coordinate with managed service providers, vendors and outsourced support partners, monitoring the quality and timeliness of assigned service delivery. General Accountabilities * Provide courteous, inclusive and professional service to users and stakeholders. * Comply with company policies, procedures, security requirements, health and safety obligations and applicable legislation. * Preserve confidentiality and exercise appropriate judgement when handling privileged, operational, personal or security-sensitive information. * Maintain technical knowledge through continuous learning and knowledge sharing * Provide emergency ICT support outside normal working hours where required to protect service continuity, respond to urgent operational issues or support approved business requirements. * Undertake other duties appropriate to the role as assigned by the Manager, Information Technology, or their designate. Reporting and Relationships Reports to: ICT Service Delivery Manager, or their designate. Direct reports: None PERSON SPECIFICATION Essential: Qualifications and Experience * An ICT-related diploma, degree or equivalent professional experience. * A minimum of five years relevant experience in an enterprise, regulated, government, critical infrastructure or similarly complex ICT environment. * Demonstrable experience providing frontline user support and Level 1 and Level 2 technical support in a service desk or enterprise ICT setting. * Experience supporting Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365 applications, user accounts, mobile devices and common enterprise peripherals. * Experience administering or supporting on-premises Active Directory and core Windows infrastructure services. * Practical experience supporting Microsoft 365 tenant services and Microsoft Entra ID. * Experience diagnosing incidents, documenting technical work and managing tickets through to resolution or effective escalation. * Experience applying cybersecurity controls, patching, endpoint protection, secure configuration and access-management principles. * Experience working with suppliers, support partners and technical specialists to restore or improve services. Technical Knowledge and Skills * Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Microsoft 365 Apps administration and support. * Identity: Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, users and groups, authentication, MFA, SSO, Conditional Access, RBAC and hybrid identity concepts. * Endpoints: Windows 10/11, device provisioning, software deployment, patching, encryption, endpoint compliance and troubleshooting. * Management platforms: working knowledge of Microsoft Intune, KACE SMA or comparable enterprise endpoint, service desk and asset management platforms. * Infrastructure: Windows Server, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file and print services, virtualisation, storage, backup and monitoring. * Networking: TCP/IP, LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, switches, routers, firewalls, secure remote access and network troubleshooting. * Security: endpoint and identity security, least privilege, logging, vulnerability remediation, incident handling and the contemporary threat landscape. * Cloud: practical understanding of Microsoft Azure administration, access control, monitoring, governance and support. * Automation: ability to use PowerShell and other approved automation tools for repeatable administrative tasks and reporting. * Service management: sound understanding of incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, configuration and asset management practices. * Documentation: ability to produce clear procedures, technical records, knowledge articles, change documentation and user guidance. Desirable: * Microsoft certifications relevant to Microsoft 365 administration, identity and access, Azure administration, endpoint administration or security. * Experience with Microsoft Defender, PIM, identity governance, security monitoring and cloud security controls. * Experience in a 24/7 operational organisation or safety-critical environment. * Knowledge of ISO 27001, ISO 9001, NIS2, GDPR and regulated operational environments. * Experience with VMware, Veeam, SolarWinds, Cisco, Check Point, SQL Server, IIS, VoIP, conferencing systems or comparable platforms. * Experience delivering infrastructure consolidation, migration, modernisation or cloud-transformation projects. * Knowledge of business intelligence, reporting and dashboard principles. * Experience supporting business continuity, disaster recovery and technical recovery exercises.

title: Water Science Graduate/Environment - Dublin - Start Jan to Oct 27
description: **Company Description** Work with Us. Change the World. At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** **About Our Team:** Our multidisciplinary water environment team are looking to recruit Water Science Graduates to join our team in eitherour Dublin office, **joining from January 2027 through to October 2027.** Our team includes specialists in hydrogeology, hydrology, hydro-morphological water quality and water resource management. We work for clients from across the public and private sectors, including the Environment Agency, Local Authorities, Highways England, Natural England, Water Utilities, Rivers and Wildlife Trusts as well as commercial developers and overseas clients. We are also involved in major ongoing projects such as HS2 and the Thames Tideway Tunnel and as a team are responsible for coordinating/ leading water environment chapters in ES’s as well as coordinating WFD assessments. All members of the Water Environment team take an active role in client contact and commercial aspects of our projects. Health, safety and environmental considerations underpin everything that we do. We have an impressive portfolio of water science projects including technical investigation, restoration projects, and impact and WFD assessment for major national and international infrastructure projects. A selection of our current and recent projects includes: We are seeking to recruit a Water Scientist to assist with a range of projects. Most of our work is in the fluvial environment, although a significant proportion is also focused on estuaries, lakes and the marine environment, and so experience of these environments is beneficial. This is a fantastic opportunity to further your career by gaining valuable work experience within a specialist surface water environment team in an established consultancy. Your work will cover a broad range of hydrological, water quality, hydro-morphological and hydro-ecological activities including on the following types of projects. **Here’s what you’ll do:** * Water quality studies (e.g. baseline studies, environmental impact assessment, nutrient loading studies and pollution studies including monitoring and modelling). * Hydrological investigations (e.g. flood, drought and water resource allocation). * Geomorphological studies, including supporting channel enhancement/ restoration projects, Natural Flood Management studies and Fluvial Audits. * hydro-morphological l studies (e.g. assessing the effects of schemes on aquatic organisms such as salmonids, freshwater pearl mussels, invertebrates and macrophytes). * WFD / Environmental Compliance studies. * EIA (e.g. highway, rail, aviation, utilities, power generation including renewables, mixed use/commercial/residential and other development types). * Pollution prevention advice including preparing Water Management Plans, acting as Environmental Clerk of Works, and developing sustainable treatment trains; and * Applications for various permissions (e.g. Environmental Permits for flood risk activities and discharges, Water Abstraction / Impoundment Licences, and Land Drainage Consents). **Enjoy the Perks** At AECOM, you'll enjoy a range of core and personalised benefits designed to support your future and well-being, customised to fit your lifestyle. Take advantage of career development opportunities, our flexible hybrid working model to ensure a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle, technical practice networks, AECOM University, and volunteering days. **Here is what you will get from us!** On the job support and learning When a graduate starts at AECOM, we pair them with a senior member of the team who will guide and mentor them through their initial period working on live projects and business development tasks, to support with any technical queries. Graduate Development Programme Our 2-year graduate ADVANCE programme is designed to help you build your career in AECOM. You will attend several instructor-led training sessions where you will meet and hear from people across the business and take part in a series of interactive activities to equip you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed in your role. Alongside the instructor-led elements of the ADVANCE programme, you will also engage with an online curriculum via AECOM University and can join the ADV ANCE webinar series. We will provide you with all the support and tools you need to achieve your professional development ambitions, which may include Chartership with the relevant international professional institution ie, Chartered Institution of Water and Environmental Management (CIWEM). We have more than 750 graduates on our programmes across the UK and Ireland from more than 40 different disciplines, each making a tangible difference to the environment in which we live and work. See our digital early careers e-brochure here **Qualifications** **Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?** Here’s what we’re looking for: * Degree qualified with an **MSc in Geography, Geomorphology, Environmental Sciences, Environmental Engineering, Hydrochemistry or similar.** * **Ability to conceptualise surface water environment issues.** * Excellent report writing skills. * Strong analytical and numerical skills. * Ability to communicative effectively, both verbally and in writing. * Have experience using GIS * A full driving licence would be beneficial as the role will involve travel for site surveys with equipment and limited public transport access We celebrate diversity, including neurodiversity, and believe it enriches our team. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and abilities. If you are an applicant with a disability that requires reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us at ReasonableAccommodations@aecom.com At AECOM, we value everyone's unique contributions and perspectives. If you meet some of the requirements above or have transferable skills you believe would benefit us, we would be delighted to hear from you! **Additional Information** Applicants are encouraged to apply as early as possible since CVs will be reviewed, and candidates selected for an advanced offer start. Please include a covering letter with your application and provide all predicted and/or obtained academic grades. Applicants must have the permanent right to work in the Republic of Ireland. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM. **Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity** You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed. You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients. AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too. Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours. We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. **ReqID:** REF59770O **Business Line:** Environment **Business Group:** DCS **Strategic Business Unit:** Europe & India **Career Area:** Science **Work Location Model:** Hybrid
